limitations: Yahoo chart endpoints are not a versioned contractual API and can change or rate-limit requests.
V1 performs one bounded request with no retry and no persistent cache.
4h is intentionally unsupported; no 1h-to-4h resampling occurs.
Yahoo limits 1h and 15m retention; missing history is not manufactured.
An exact rolling 60-day 15m live request returned HTTP 422; 59 days succeeded.
Monthly resolution_seconds uses a nominal 30-day transport value because the existing Timeframe model requires a positive integer.
The existing normalizer sorts out-of-order rows and retains duplicate timestamps while reporting them.
Required-OHLC null rows are excluded and reported; malformed non-null numbers fail closed.
Yahoo quote OHLC is used without independently applying adjusted close or interpreting corporate actions.
No pivot discovery, candidate generation, Elliott analysis, indicators, ranking, or trading is included.
P005 remains unchanged; P006 remains unchanged with its unresolved conflict.
